notes.title: Version 0.8.15
notes.notes: The army variable in the Fortress and Defense stages was changed to enemyArmy.

notes.title: Version 0.8.14
notes.notes:
Changed the appearance of the durability bar.
 Corrected the spelling of Items.Weat in the Economy stage.

notes.title: Version 0.8.13
notes.notes: Fixed the problem that the German keyboard does not allow to input text while pressing the Alt Gr key.

notes.title: Version 0.8.12
notes.notes:
Corrected comments in en/items.lua.


To incorporate changes in items.lua, it is recommended to temporarily change the language. (This operation will update _api folder)

notes.title: Version 0.8.11
notes.notes: Fixed a script error in the Counterattack stage.

notes.title: Version 0.8.10
notes.notes:
[olist]
 Allowed to eat as long as the max fullness is not exceeded.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 0.8.9
notes.notes: The name of the order class was changed to orderData.

notes.title: Version 0.8.8
notes.notes: Hid the background image of the checkbox for whether the recipe order is valid.

notes.title: Version 0.8.7
notes.notes: Fixed npc:sleep() not finishing when the maximum value of stamina and satiety is more than 100.

notes.title: Version 0.8.6
notes.notes:
Fixed npc:work() not increasing experience.
 Fixed that building:stopOrder() also deletes unrelated task cards.
 Increased the number of initial items in the Counterattack stage.

notes.title: Version 0.8.5
notes.notes:
Corrected incorrect task description.
 Fixed some bugs.


If you have already played “Build a fortress”, please delete and recreate the setup.lua for that stage.

notes.title: Version 0.8.4
notes.notes:
Fixed the dying when an adventurer party overlaps with an enemy army.
 Added Ctrl+S save description to the first world stage.
 Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Version 0.8.3
notes.notes:
Fixed npc:canWork() not working properly.
 Fixed disappearance of put()ed items in a building.
 Increased the number of storage units in the kitchen.
 Changed the recipe for meat and eggs.

notes.title: Version 0.8.2
notes.notes:
Fixed npc:move() error message.
 Added a cart stage.
 Fix wrong position of magic effects.

notes.title: Version 0.8.1
notes.notes:
Added "Haute Cuisine" stage to the additional stages.
Fixed that not all buildings are displayed in the building list.
Changed some of the food recipes.
Adjustments were made to the UI.
